premises.text: Early-stage circuit-board prototyping via China fab is slow and costly (hundreds of dollars and ~two weeks), and mistakes restart the wait loop
premises.evidence_span: Most designers outsource fabrication to facilities in China, pay a couple hundred dollars, and wait two weeks for delivery

premises.text: Volterra prints circuit boards in about lunch-break time using silver nanoparticle ink, including multi-layer boards and solder-paste dispense/bake for beta units
premises.evidence_span: a printer that can create a circuit board in the time it takes to go get lunch

premises.text: Customers buy the printer and purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates through the website
premises.evidence_span: our customers will be able to purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates directly through our website

premises.text: Hardware developers across large tech, startups, academia, and hobbyists need faster in-house electronics prototyping (desk-side printer goal)
premises.evidence_span: They all agree that hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics

value.text: Custom circuits in under about an hour instead of weeks, helping people reach manufacturing faster and save cost
value.evidence_span: help people get there faster and save huge costs along the way

causal_links.evidence_span: the choice between lead times of two weeks or just 60 minutes is an easy one to make
With Volterra, if you need custom circuits, just press print
it's our goal to put a printer on every one of their designers' desks

notes: China fab wait/cost/error restart and hobbyist toxic etching folded as one prototyping-access problem (§4.1.6). Ink, multi-layer sandwich, and solder-paste/bake folded as feature cascade of one printer (§4.1.7). RFID/Arduino/hobbyist uses treated as applications of the same mechanism (§4.1.2).
